# NovaMind AI — Sales & CRM AI Attribution Report

**Reporting Period:** Q2 2026  |  **Prepared by:** Revenue Operations  |  **Distribution:** CRO, Portfolio Operations

## 1. Win Rate Analysis

AI-assisted win rate this quarter: 52.0% (deals where the sales team used the AI deal-scoring and underwriting-assist tool). Non-AI win rate (deals closed without AI tooling): 38.0%.

This represents an AI win rate uplift of +14 percentage points this quarter, the largest gap recorded since the AI sales-assist tool was rolled out.

## 2. Revenue Attribution Detail

| Revenue Line Item                                   | Revenue Line Amount   | AI Attribution Type         |
|-----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------|-----------------------------|
| Direct AI underwriting product revenue              | $9.8M                 | direct_ai_revenue           |
| AI-assisted lending workflow revenue                | $6.1M                 | ai_assisted_revenue         |
| AI-sourced pipeline revenue converted to closed-won | $2.5M                 | pipeline_influenced_revenue |
| Cross-sell revenue (pre-AI baseline cohort)         | $4.2M                 | cross_sell_revenue_baseline |
| Cross-sell revenue (AI-enabled cohort)              | $6.1M                 | cross_sell_revenue_with_ai  |

Direct AI revenue of $9.8M, AI assisted revenue of $6.1M, and pipeline influenced revenue of $2.5M together account for the company's $18.4M AI-attributed revenue this quarter.

## 3. Cross-Sell Performance

Cross-sell revenue with AI ($6.1M) outperformed the cross-sell baseline revenue ($4.2M) by 45%, attributed to AI-enabled product recommendation in the customer success workflow.

## 4. Net Revenue Retention (AI Cohort)

| Metric                   | Value   |
|--------------------------|---------|
| Starting ARR (AI cohort) | $60.0M  |
| Expansion                | $18.0M  |
| Churn                    | $3.6M   |

AI-driven net revenue retention for the quarter: 124% — (Starting ARR + Expansion − Churn) / Starting ARR for the AI-enabled customer cohort.

## 5. Pipeline Summary

Pipeline influenced revenue (AI-sourced pipeline revenue) attributable to the AI marketing and lead-scoring tools this quarter totaled $2.5M, representing 14% of total new pipeline generated.
